name: bolt-altcha-assets
description: Vendors the ALTCHA widget into assets/altcha/ (published to public/assets/altcha/ by `extensions:configure`). After changing the version: `npm ci && npm run build`, bump WidgetRenderer::ASSETS_VERSION and commit assets/.

scripts.build: rm -rf assets/altcha/workers && mkdir -p assets/altcha/workers && cp node_modules/altcha/dist/external/altcha.min.js assets/altcha/altcha.js && cp node_modules/altcha/dist/external/altcha.css assets/altcha/altcha.css && cp node_modules/altcha/dist/workers/pbkdf2.js node_modules/altcha/dist/workers/sha.js assets/altcha/workers/ && cp node_modules/altcha/LICENSE.txt assets/altcha/LICENSE.txt
